# furchert.ch — Dominic Furchert

> Personal website of Dominic Furchert, a software engineer in the Zürcher Oberland (Zurich Oberland), Switzerland. He helps small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs, German: KMU) in the Zürcher Oberland use AI in their everyday work, and he shows his software and homelab projects. The site is in German (default) and English.

- Offer: AI for SMEs in the Zürcher Oberland (services, trades and production). Free first conversation on site or by video, then one trial run with a written quote. Accounting and bookkeeping are not part of the offer.
- Data protection: processing in Switzerland or the EU wherever possible; sensitive data only with Swiss providers or on the customer's own premises.
- Background: trained as an application developer (EFZ) at UBS; studies Software Systems (BSc) at the University of Zurich.
- Volunteer roles: president of the Ruderclub Rapperswil-Jona (about 200 members), safety chief of the national rowing regatta in Schmerikon, firefighter, J+S coach.
- German pages are under /de, English pages under /en.

## Pages

- [KI für KMU im Zürcher Oberland](https://furchert.ch/de/automation): the AI offer for SMEs, with examples, process, data protection and FAQ. English: [AI for SMEs in the Zürcher Oberland](https://furchert.ch/en/automation)
- [Über mich](https://furchert.ch/de/about): background, timeline and roles. English: [About](https://furchert.ch/en/about)
- [Projekte](https://furchert.ch/de/projects): software and homelab projects. English: [Projects](https://furchert.ch/en/projects)
- [IT & Tech](https://furchert.ch/de/it): professional experience and tech stack. English: [IT & Tech](https://furchert.ch/en/it)
- [Rudern](https://furchert.ch/de/rowing): rowing club presidency and regatta safety. English: [Rowing](https://furchert.ch/en/rowing)
- [Kontakt](https://furchert.ch/de/contact): contact form and public profiles. English: [Contact](https://furchert.ch/en/contact)

## Projects

- [Homelab Infrastructure as Code](https://furchert.ch/en/projects/homelab): a 4-node k3s cluster provisioned with Ansible.
- [IoT Platform — Terra1](https://furchert.ch/en/projects/iot-platform): ESP32 sensor nodes, MQTT and Spring Boot services.
- [Homelab Auth Service](https://furchert.ch/en/projects/auth-service): identity and access management for the homelab.
- [RCRJ Club Assist](https://furchert.ch/en/projects/club-assist): AI-assisted club management for the rowing club.
- [Aemtlifyer](https://furchert.ch/en/projects/aemtlifyer): role and task management for the rowing club.
- [Karaokee — SoPra FS26](https://furchert.ch/en/projects/karaokee): group karaoke app, a university software project.
